text: The RWB-ITG-E6030-ITG harness runs in SIT on the synthetic partner PRT-SYN-0030 and the case RW-2027-000830, with panel version PNLV-SYN-0030-v2, fee schedule FS-SYN-0030-v2 in force on business date 2027-04-30 and FS-SYN-0030-v3 effective from the next business date, the service levels held by partner type in the fixture; the fixture advances the business date instead of waiting on a schedule; and the run uses stubs generated from the published contracts from Day 1 and the real service as RWB-S9-E6030-APP lands, with the P3 reference-data contract a C dependency built against its published fake so it never blocks.
why: The sources give no harness environment, fixture layout, synthetic keys, panel or fee-schedule version identifiers, service-level values, business date, next effective date, evidence format or gate, and the Ownership Map publishes no panel-version or fee-schedule load operation; the run continues under this ruling instead of stopping, and none of these values is a business value that a business person may change.
